title: Syracuse students film paranormal series at Becker Mansion
excerpt: Syracuse University students filmed an episode of their paranormal investigation series at the Becker Mansion in Seneca Falls. The episode is planned for Orange Television Network’s YouTube channel.
content:
Seneca County

Syracuse University students filmed an episode of their paranormal investigation series at the Becker Mansion in Seneca Falls. The episode is planned for Orange Television Network’s YouTube channel.

Syracuse University students visited the Becker Mansion in Seneca Falls on Friday night to film an episode of their paranormal investigation series, “Haunt on the Hill.”

The Seneca Falls Historical Society said it hosted the students as they explored stories of hauntings at the mansion. The series is produced by Syracuse University’s Orange Television Network.

The students brought EMF detectors, a Spirit Box, a REM-Pod and flashlights for the investigation, the historical society said. Photos accompanying its announcement show cameras and other equipment set up inside the mansion.

The historical society did not disclose what the students experienced during the visit, saying those details would be revealed in the episode.

The episode will be posted on Orange Television Network’s YouTube channel, and the historical society plans to share it. A release date was not announced.
